newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to renew repo pact with Malaysia, Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Manila to renew repo pact with Malaysia, Indonesia.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it would renew the bilateral repurchase lines with the central banks of Malaysia and Indonesia.
These agreements were formulated by a number of Asian central banks in the aftermath of the 1995 Mexican crisis. These provide ready liquidity in case their currency comes under speculative attack.
By offering their U.S. treasury holdings with a promise to buy back at a later date, participating central banks can raise the neede cash without liquidating their security holdings.
The Philippines renewed its pact with Thailand last week.
It had previously signed accords with its counterparts in Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, and China.
